business.about: Astral Poly Technik Ltd was established in 1996, with the aim to manufacture pro-India plumbing and drainage systems in the country. The company is into manufacturing of Pipes, water tanks, bathware, specialised valves, paints, adhesives and sealants, infrastructure solutions, specialised fittings and construction chemicals. [1]

promises.opening: welcome all to the Earnings Call of Q2 FY2027 and the First Half Year Results of FY2027 for the Astral business. As you are all aware, the polymer industry is passing through a volatile time. The prices are highly volatile and fluctuating, but due to the implementation of MIP, we feel that now at least the downward side is protected, and the industry will b enefit from this. I am very happy to share that this quarter was very good quarter for the industry. Demand was good across the board. The reason was that Q1 was very negative for the pipe industry, and the trade was sitting on a very low inventory, which supported all-round demand. We at Astral always focused on profitability, volume growth, and market share gains, which we have once again demonstrated in this quarter with a 19.10% volume growth and 10.1% volume growth for H1. This is not only the highest in the industry, but also comes with a very healthy EBITDA margin of 17.4% in H1 against the company's guidance of double -digit volume growth and 16% -18% margin. This clearly suggests that Astral has been continuously gaining market share for many years, and this journey will continue. Now, let me take you through all our verticals. Plumbing. Demand was overall good in the industry, and so was the demand for Astral. But because of the decentralizations of the plant, our demand was very good, and because we are gaining market share in new geographies where we have started new plants. As you are aware, Astral has spent sizable amount of capex in last four to five years across all verticals, and now it is the time to utilize the same and generate cash flows from there on. Astral Limited November 05, 2026 Page 3 of 19 As communicated in the past, we have increased our product basket in last three to four years, and since its base is still low, we are delivering good performance in products like Watertech, valves, fire sprinkler, OPVC, PTMT, our various low -noise pipe segments. We have also launched a complete range of PPR pipes and fittings, and also electrofusion HDPE drainage system is going to be launched very shortly. All these new segments have been giving us healthy margins. The major thing, the construction of CPVC plant is almost complete. The machinery installation is going on. It is as per schedule, but some of the things are going early than the schedules, and we are expecting to complete all our trials in the first month of Q4, and we will be commercially ready with the CPVC production by the last month of Q4. Our state-of-the-art machines for the new value-added products, Pex, aluminum Pex, has been installed, stabilized, and now it is starting its commercial production. In Q3, it will be in this quarter, Pex, aluminum Pex will be commercially sold from Astral, from its own plant and from its own product basket. Apart from there, I think going forward also, I would like to clearly give a guidance that the month -- for the last month -- and this month has been a robust demand for the piping segment. And we expect our growth at that robust pace to continue and deliver a healthy margin in this quarter. Bathware. The bathware business is also picking up, and more and more new projects and developers are being added to Astral brand. During this quarter, we have given a healthy growth of 26.8%. Adhesive business. This quarter was once again excellent for adhesive business in India and overseas. We have delivered a robust growth of 25.3% and 30.10% respectively. We are getting a good response in the rural and online business from all our product line and all the segments. At the same time, overseas business is also picking up very well. I am sure you must have seen that in this vertical, we are continuously growing our market share by entering new geographies, introducing new products, and focusing on rural and overseas market.
